compress.name: Compress PDF
compress.desc: Shrink a scanned PDF without uploading it anywhere

compress.title: Compress PDF
compress.description: Make a PDF smaller in your browser — no upload, no queue
compress.seoTitle: Compress PDF Free – Shrink a PDF Without Uploading
compress.seoDescription: Shrink a PDF in your browser. The lossless level keeps text selectable; the image levels can halve a scan. Pick a level, compare both sizes, keep the smaller file.

intro.compress: Make a PDF smaller without sending it anywhere. The lossless level repacks the file and keeps the text selectable; the image levels can halve a scan, at the cost of turning its pages into pictures.

stepAction.compress: Pick a level and compress; try another level if the first one is not enough.

compress: Email attachments that bounce because of an inbox size limit.
Scanned contracts and reports kept on a phone with little storage.
Upload portals that reject a CV or an invoice above 5 MB.

compress.q: Will compressing make the text blurry?
compress.a: On the lossless level, no: only the file structure is rewritten, so text and images are untouched. The image levels do lower the resolution, which is exactly what makes them work — check the result before you delete the original.

upload.prompt: Click or drag a PDF file here to make it smaller
upload.hint: Lossless keeps the text selectable; the image levels shrink scans the most

levels.label: Compression level
levels.lightBody: Rewrites the file structure. Text stays selectable — expect a few percent.
levels.balancedBody: Renders each page at 150 DPI as JPEG. Text becomes an image.
levels.strongBody: 110 DPI at lower quality. Smallest result, softest text.

result.heading: Result
result.notSmaller: This file cannot get smaller at this level: the result is the same size or larger, so there is nothing to download. Try Balanced or Strong if you really need it under a limit.
result.rasterNote: Every page is now a picture. Keep the original if you may need to search, select or edit the text later.
result.losslessNote: The text was not touched — it is still selectable and searchable.

warning.heavy: Large files take a while to render. Keep this tab open; you can cancel between pages.

errors.encrypted: This PDF is password-protected. Open it once with its password, save an unlocked copy, then compress that.
errors.readFailed: This file could not be read as a PDF. Please try another one.
errors.compressFailed: Something went wrong while compressing. The original file is untouched.
